title: Outer-2 dynamic response divergence decomposition

technical_history.repair: The general research runner now treats the exact persisted G21 outer-2 assertion as an expected-negative regression. G21 success or any different G21 failure remains fail-closed. No G21 or G21A scientific gate changed.

fresh_response_variants.name: G21_ANCHOR_G17_TANGENT
fresh_response_variants.interpretation: Changing only anchor/q-reference at the G21 anchor while retaining the G17 tangent has negligible head effect.

fresh_response_variants.name: G17_ANCHOR_G21_TANGENT
fresh_response_variants.interpretation: The subthreshold fresh-response difference is almost entirely associated with the tiny E3 tangent change, not the anchor head offset itself.

bounded_conclusions: The 4.440892098500626e-16 m outer-1 head offset changes the independently fresh-solved outer-2 response head by only -1.978417429882029e-13 m, below the preregistered 1e-12 m materiality threshold.

Cross-evaluation shows that this already-small response-parameter effect is almost entirely associated with a 6.167906494690411e-14 s^-1 change in the finite-difference E3 tangent; the anchor/q-reference shift with the G17 tangent changes the fresh root by less than 1e-15 m.
Applying the exact same G21-native outer-2 affine response after the continuous outer-1 lambda history produces a head 7.235179122488944e-11 m away from its fresh-origin solution.
The response-parameter and prepared-solve-path components sum exactly to the observed G21 outer-2 divergence of 7.215394948190124e-11 m.

G21 is therefore falsified because of prepared-solve path dependence at the strict G17 trajectory-equivalence scale, not because the dynamic E3 response materially changed after the outer-1 floating-point head offset.

This diagnosis does not invalidate G20: 7.24e-11 m remains far inside the much looser inherited F-GC38 path-equivalence envelope, while G21 deliberately imposed a stricter 1e-12 m path-reproduction requirement.
No production policy, F-GC38/F-GC39 contract, E3/P4 rule, HCOF/RHS semantics or accepted state was changed.
next_natural_unit: Open G21B to diagnose the continuous prepared-solve path effect itself: determine whether the first MODFLOW convergence report under the changed outer-2 response is path-dependent at the strict G17 scale, whether additional same-response solve calls reduce the 7.24e-11 m offset, and what internal convergence/state criterion would be required before proposing any new research coupling acceptance rule.
